annotation.authors_or_issuer: European Parliament and Council of the European Union
key_provisions_or_claims: Establishes harmonised rules for development, placing on the market and use of AI systems in the EU
Risk-based approach with prohibited practices and high-risk system requirements
Aligned with the New Legislative Framework for product safety and conformity assessment
Amends vehicle, civil aviation and rail regulations/directives to integrate AI requirements
Supports innovation, SMEs and protection of fundamental rights, health and safety
annotation.summary_en: Finnish-language Official Journal text of Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 (AI Act), laying down harmonised AI rules and amending several vehicle, aviation and rail acts. Excerpt covers recitals on internal market, fundamental rights, human-centric trustworthy AI, risk-based high-risk rules aligned with the New Legislative Framework, and biometric categorisation.

annotation.title_en: Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 of the European Parliament and of the Council laying down harmonised rules on artificial intelligence (Artificial Intelligence Act)
